name: The Family Crypt
summary: Scourge forces at the Agamand Mills threaten the Forsaken's hold on Tirisfal. From Brill, Magistrate Sevren sends agents against the undead in the family crypt.

sections.title: A Foxtrot in Tirisfal
sections.body: The Forsaken hold Tirisfal Glades, but the Scourge still grips much of its countryside. The Agamand Mills once produced flour for Lordaeron; now they are a Scourge stronghold. In Brill, Magistrate Sevren watches the enemy gather with grave concern. Every stretch of land lost to the undead weakens the Forsaken's independence.

sections.title: Defiling the Tomb
sections.body: Captain Dargol, a skeletal commander, has made the Agamand Family Crypt his headquarters. Through necromancy, he raises generations of the Agamand dead as Rotting and Wailing Ancestors to swell his ranks. Magistrate Sevren sends Forsaken agents to purge the crypt, lay the disturbed dead to rest, and sever Dargol's head to disrupt Scourge forces in northern Tirisfal.

faq.answer: Captain Dargol is a skeletal Scourge officer based in the Agamand Family Crypt. He commands local Scourge forces and uses necromancy to raise Agamand ancestors against the Forsaken.

faq.q: Why does Magistrate Sevren care about the Agamand Mills?
faq.answer: The Agamand Mills are a major Scourge foothold close to Brill and the Undercity. Captain Dargol's growing force of raised ancestors threatens the Forsaken settlements.

faq.q: Who are the Wailing and Rotting Ancestors?
faq.answer: The Wailing and Rotting Ancestors are dead forebears of the wealthy Agamand family. Captain Dargol's necromancy has corrupted them and bound them to the Scourge.

faq.q: What happens after Dargol is killed?
faq.answer: Returning Captain Dargol's skull to Magistrate Sevren breaks the Scourge's central leadership at the mills. Sevren hails the victory as a critical strike for the Forsaken and an early step toward purging the Lich King's influence from Lordaeron.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, Captain Dargol embodies the enslavement to the Lich King's will they fought to escape. Putting down the raised ancestors protects their people and helps break the Scourge's hold on their homeland.
For the Horde, securing Tirisfal Glades helps anchor its presence in the Eastern Kingdoms and removes immediate threats to its northern stronghold.
